headline: Water Bombing Helicopter Crashes Into Barito River In South Kalimantan
seoTitle: Helicopter Crashes During Water Bombing In South Kalimantan
metaDescription: A Super Puma helicopter contracted by the Indonesian disaster agency crashed into the Barito River; all three crew members have been rescued safely.
aiSummaryBullets: A Super Puma water-bombing helicopter crashed into the Barito River in South Kalimantan while collecting water for forest fire suppression.
The aircraft, operated under contract by the National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB), carried three crew members who were safely evacuated.
Authorities have confirmed the identities of the rescued crew as two foreign nationals and one Indonesian citizen.
aiContextParagraph: On November 8, 2026, an Eurocopter EC225LP Super Puma helicopter, leased by the Indonesian National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) for forest and land fire suppression operations, experienced a crash while operating near the Barito River in the Tabatan Village area, Barito Kuala Regency, South Kalimantan. The incident occurred as the crew was attempting to retrieve water for fire-extinguishing efforts. Following the crash, emergency response teams successfully evacuated all three crew members on board, consisting of two foreign nationals and one Indonesian citizen. The BNPB has initiated an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the event. This incident is distinct from other recent aviation emergencies involving firefighting operations in the Kalimantan region, which have necessitated medical evacuations for affected crew members to hospitals in Jakarta and Semarang.
whyItIsViral: The incident has reached maximum viral intensity due to high media coverage velocity and significant public interest following widely circulated footage of the crash.
